name: A Sacrifice in Vain
summary: Elegael Thornpaw fears the Al'Aketh Cultists will overwhelm the wounded in her den. A message meant for Valanaar has not reached them, leaving her to ask for help.

sections.title: A Plea for Aid
sections.body: The Al'Aketh Cultists fell upon Elegael Thornpaw's fellows with almost no warning. Many in her den are wounded or dying, and she does not know how long they can survive the attack. She had tried to send word to Valanaar, but the message did not get through. With no reinforcements in sight, Elegael asks you to help.

faq.answer: Elegael Thornpaw asks for help as the Al'Aketh Cultists attack her fellows.

faq.q: What happened to the people in the den?
faq.answer: The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed them with little warning. Many are wounded or dying.

faq.q: Why did Valanaar not send reinforcements?
faq.answer: Elegael's message did not reach Valanaar, so reinforcements have not arrived.
Elegael asks you to help her wounded fellows survive the Al'Aketh Cultists' attack.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Sacrifice in Vain
